title: passiflora candollei
intro: Passiflora candollei, commonly known as the red passionflower, is a species of flowering plant in the passionflower family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include reducing anxiety and insomnia due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Passiflora candollei include sedative and antispasmodic effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of stress and muscle tension. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
